name: obelisk-installer
tagline_zh: 电脑里没装 obelisk？一条命令帮你装好 CLI 和技能，顺带修复坏掉的安装。不用翻文档，不用猜路径。
tagline_en: Missing obelisk? One command installs CLI + skill, even repairs broken setups. No docs, no path guessing, ready.
desc_en: Install the official Obelisk CLI and then install the Obelisk agent skill. Use only for initial setup or repair when the `obelisk` command is missing.
why_zh: 同类安装器只装文件，它连技能一起装好，还能检测并修复缺失命令，省掉手动排查的麻烦。
why_en: Unlike plain installers, it bundles the skill and auto-repairs missing commands, saving manual troubleshooting.
